'''Avaro Sookcool''' was an obese [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who was the uncle of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] albeit with a lisp.

==Biography==
He owned [[Flip of the Credit]], a small [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. As his small casino was part of a larger complex operated by the part of the cartel that was dedicated to money-laundering, Avaro was an operative for [[Clezo]], the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]]. Clezo, however, did not know that Avaro reported to [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] himself as well as to him. Sookcool coordinated most of the organization's businesses on the planet and his own subordinates were owners of most of the planet's casinos and pleasure halls.<ref name="SOTEsb" /> 

Avaro was one of the few who survived [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red's]] [[Tetsu Clan]] purges, and this thanks to his ties to Black Sun, which Navik did not dare to cross.<ref name="SOTEsb" /><ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] needed some ties to Black Sun in rescuing the captured [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and also to learn who wanted [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] dead, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] thought of Avaro as a contact. They met in his office. Despite Greedo having been killed by Han, he held no grudge.<Ref>{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=It'th Greedo'th Uncle|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC023.jpg}}</ref> Eventually he arranged for them a meeting with [[Guri]].
==Personality and traits==
Avaro had the looks of a typical innocuous aged businessman, chubby with hanging skin; his color had faded into dull green. He was rather intelligent and efficient businessman, and his lisp simply gave a different impression.<ref name="SOTEsb" />

He paid attention to appearance and diplomacy, as means to avoid trouble. At first he looked friendly to strangers, but he never offered information for free. As a Black Sun agent, he was not overly ambitious, but defended his rank.<ref name="SOTEsb" />
